chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said: “What prevents any of you from performing hajj every year?”

It was said to him: “Our wealth does not reach that.” So he said: “Is none of you able, when his brother sets out, to send with him the price of a sacrificial animal and instruct him to perform a circumambulation of the House on his behalf and to slaughter on his behalf? Then, when it is the Day of Arafah, he should put on his clothes, prepare himself, and come to the mosque, and continue in supplication until the sun sets.”

key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: around the Ka'bah, the Sacred House
key_terms.ثَمَنِ أُضْحِيَّةٍ: the price of a sacrificial animal

ai.seo_question: How can someone share in the reward of hajj if they cannot afford to go every year?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages believers to maintain a continual connection to hajj even when they are financially unable to perform it every year. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches an alternative act: deputing part of the rite through another pilgrim and spending the Day of Arafah in du'a, showing the spiritual value of intention, participation, and worship according to one's means.
